MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "General repair glue felt related to my recent nails, screws, and anchors because it offers another way to attach or repair things.",
    "The Gorilla glue interested me for ordinary repairs, although the ten-pack kept it from being something I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Metal-cutting wheels and a PEX cinch tool require specific tasks that my fastening purchases do not establish.",
    "A replacement power-tool switch needs a known repair need and compatible tool; neither is evident from my recent purchases.",
    "Vacuum bags do not imply that I need spray bottles or soap and towel dispensers.",
    "The large thin-adhesive refill is aimed at specialized work, while my wood screws only suggest fastening needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My nails and screws seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when it serves a different task.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase seemed to be stretched into a broader need for cleaning and dispensing supplies.",
    "Buying some fastening supplies in quantity does not mean I want large quantities of glue or cutting wheels."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The strongest repeated pattern is fastening and mounting, so the particular job an item helps me do matters more than a general repair connection.",
    "I need an immediate use before choosing specialized tools or replacement parts; possible usefulness alone is not enough.",
    "Package size and intended use matter: ordinary repair glue can interest me without making a ten-pack or a large specialty refill appropriate."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my repair interests but extended them into unrelated tasks and quantities I do not currently need."
}
